description: Electric Vehicle Rebate 2018 is a dataset listed in State of Oregon open data portal (data.oregon.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Oregon. DEQ invites the public to comment on the Electric Vehicle Rebate Rulemaking 2019 from Nov. 1 to Nov. 27, 2018. Comments submitted outside this time frame will not be considered. Coverage: Oregon. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2018-11-15 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oregon-gov-portal.
